system_name: Customer LTV Model for Paid Acquisition Bidding

business_goal: Improve customer acquisition spend across paid channels by targeting potential high value customers
assumptions: CAC alone is a weak business metric, since low value customers can also have low CAC
Model predicts 30 day LTV; the 12 month LTV sent to ad platforms is 30 day LTV × a cohort multiplier (brand, channel, country)
problem_framing: Prediction horizon: first 30 days after signup
Offline metric: RMSE on mean of deciles
Serving: Online inference, or hourly micro batch
Downstream decision: value based bidding signal sent to ad platforms
Online test: Treatment vs control, campaign split
